posts.name: Roger the Alien
posts.cooked:
I know we do not even have VotM in our "digital hands" but a person asked this in the comments: 

I'm curious about the digital application, though. Will OblivAeon content be added before or after everyone receives their orders, seeing as how it may take several weeks to ship to everyone?

Christopher answered: That's more up to Handelabra than anyone, though I would be surprised if it happened before everyone got it. There's a LOT of programming that will go into making OblivAeon mode happen.

Edit: 

An additional question was asked: Well, I was referring more to the Mini-Packs. It seems to me that Mini-pack four, with Stuntman and Benchmark, could be done and shipped before everyone receives OblivAeon.

Christopher answered: True! I want to make sure that they hit the table first, though. We'll see what happens there - I'm sure that's a thing that I'll be talking to the fine folks at Handelabra about sooner rather than later.

I still need to create Challenge Modes for Villains - the hold up there is entirely my fault. Only so much game design time in an 18 hour day.
